# Kanvas One

> Kanvas One designs, builds and looks after websites for small businesses in the UK, with a North East team working across Newcastle, North Tyneside and Northumberland. A business gets its website built for it and live within 24 hours for £9.99 a month, with the web address, hosting, security, support and unlimited changes to its words and photos included. Joining takes two minutes: the business name, an email, a web address and a link to where the business is already online, then payment. No setup fee, no VAT, no contract: cancel any month.

## The offer

- Starter, £9.99 a month: the website, built for them from Kanvas One's designs and live within 24 hours, with their own web address (domain), hosting, security, a contact or quote form, click to call, Google and AI search set up, and unlimited changes to their words and photos made by the team, worked through in turn. No setup fee.
- Built from what they already have: they send a link to their Instagram, Facebook or current site when they join, and the site is built from it. More photos or changes can be sent any time.
- Business, £49 a month (first month half price): everything in Starter plus online bookings, payments, live chat, reviews asked for automatically and changes done within 48 hours.
- Max, £249 a month: a growth service that also runs the business's Facebook and Instagram ads and works on its Google ranking every month. The business pays its own ad spend.
- Annual: £99 a year for Starter (two months free).
- Live on the business's own web address within 24 hours of joining. If they leave, the web address is transferred to them free.

## How it compares with a local web design agency

A small business website from a local agency typically costs £1,000 to £3,000 or more up front, takes weeks, and often bills hosting and changes on top. Kanvas One costs £9.99 a month all in, with no setup fee, is online within 24 hours, and changes to words and photos are unlimited.

## Who it's for

Small and local businesses that need a proper website without agency prices: trades (electricians, heating engineers, plumbers), hairdressers, barbers, lash artists, makeup artists, nail techs, cake makers, kids' clubs, dance schools, gyms, driving instructors, mobile car valeters, cleaners, gardeners, tutors, photographers and coffee shops.

## Areas

Based in the North East of England. Web design for Newcastle upon Tyne (Gosforth, Jesmond, Heaton, Gateshead), North Tyneside (North Shields, Tynemouth, Whitley Bay, Wallsend, Killingworth) and Northumberland (Cramlington, Blyth, Morpeth, Ashington, Bedlington, Hexham, Alnwick, Berwick-upon-Tweed). Everything is done online, so businesses anywhere in the UK can use it.
